verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents that managed devices are assigned to the company account and centrally managed by the administrator within the company profile, which covers the shared-console part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows a shared address book, grouping of machines and users, or access policies applied per group; 'custom monitoring policies' cover monitoring, not access control. Missing for 10: shared address book of users and machines, group organization, per-group access policies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, machines and users are organized in a shared address book or console with per-group access policies

citations.quote: Managed devices are devices assigned to the company account and centrally managed within the company profile by the administrator.
